class Money
  include Comparable

  attr_reader :cents

  def initialize(cents)
    @cents = cents
    freeze
  end

  def <=>(other)
    return nil unless other.is_a?(Money)

    cents <=> other.cents
  end

  def eql?(other)
    other.is_a?(Money) && cents.eql?(other.cents)
  end

  def hash
    cents.hash
  end

  def to_s
    sign = cents.negative? ? "-" : ""
    amount = cents.abs
    "%s$%d.%02d" % [sign, amount / 100, amount % 100]
  end
end
